study: q20 detector-aware model v3: train-only beam/iris/z nuisance calibration plus compact complex residual

physical_nuisance.interpretation: model-bound nuisance registration only; beam radius, iris radius and absolute z require independent bench calibration

phase_plane: selected-order field immediately before the axicon

miao_method_relation.reference: B. Miao, L. Feder, J. E. Shrock and H. M. Milchberg, Phase front retrieval and correction of Bessel beams, Opt. Express 30, 11360-11371 (2022), doi:10.1364/OE.454796
miao_method_relation.use: intensity-only Bessel wavefront retrieval motivates compact low-order pupil phase coordinates; the present model additionally propagates through the explicit bench route and evaluates held-out z planes

hardware_blockers: SLM2-to-axicon/input-plane coordinate transform and conjugacy not independently calibrated
SLM2 parity, rotation, scale and centre not independently measured
SLM2 1030 nm grey-to-phase LUT/stroke not calibrated
poster_boundary: Measured evidence stops at the pre-correction z-stack and inverse diagnosis. Any corrected field generated from this candidate must be labelled numerical prediction.
